definition.title: Three Crossings
definition.briefing: Hold any two of the three marked expansion approaches continuously for three minutes. Enemy recon can reveal concealed scouts, so use cover with escape routes. Keep the marked scout concealed for one full minute before its observation mark is awarded.
definition.debrief: Three Crossings: the operational goal is complete. Review losses, objective state and recorded orders before continuing Operation Open Road.
definition.rules_notice: Scenario: authored starting assets, finite warned enemy columns, and mission-specific objectives. Standard unit stats, Supply, paid production, service, power, capture and combat rules apply. Difficulty changes enemy budgets, composition and entry timing only.

objectives.text: Lose all HQs, production structures and engineering rigs.
Hold any two approaches continuously for three minutes.
Optional: keep the marked scout concealed for one uninterrupted minute.

actions.text: WATCH: Hostile column 1 is approaching the eastern road. Expected entry varies with difficulty; screen the marked approach.
WATCH: Column 1 has entered. Its approach is east.
WATCH: Hostile column 2 is approaching the northwestern pass. Expected entry varies with difficulty; screen the marked approach.
WATCH: Column 2 has entered. Its approach is northwest.
WATCH: Hostile column 3 is approaching the eastern road. Expected entry varies with difficulty; screen the marked approach.
WATCH: Column 3 has entered. Its approach is east.
OPERATIONS: One approach is held. A second must remain secure for the full three-minute count.
